name: structuring-logical-ideas
description: Structures topics, problems, and project ideas into rigorously nested SCQA, PREP, Pyramid MECE, and STAR analyses with Markdown mind maps and searchable PDF reports.

interface.longDescription: Turn a topic, problem situation, or project idea into a traceable decision argument. The plugin identifies context, stakeholders, timing, constraints, decision owner, thesis, definitions, assumptions, causal paths, recurring tensions, audience-specific explanations, actions, and validation metrics. It produces a 300-character summary, a Markdown mind map, and a searchable PDF. Its required nesting is SCQA > Answer > PREP, with a MECE Pyramid inside Reason and STAR inside Example or supporting facts.
defaultPrompt: Turn this topic into a rigorous argument, nested mind map, and PDF report.
Analyze this problem with SCQA, then nest PREP, Pyramid MECE, and STAR.
Stress-test this project idea and turn the reasoning into actions and metrics.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release. Converts topics, problem situations, and project ideas into structured analyses using strictly nested SCQA, PREP, Pyramid MECE, and STAR models, then produces a Markdown mind map and searchable PDF report.

zh-TW.subtitle: 將構想轉為邏輯報告
zh-TW.description: 將特定主題、問題情境或專案構想整理為可追溯的決策論證。輸出背景與限制、300 字摘要、關鍵字與變數、決策主體、核心論點、概念邊界、因果路徑、潛在衝突、分眾說明、行動與驗證指標；並以 SCQA 為外層，在 Answer 內嵌 PREP、在 Reason 內嵌符合 MECE 的金字塔、在 Example 或底層事實內嵌 STAR，最後產生 Markdown 思維導圖與可搜尋 PDF。
